name: Custom vessel
description: Any monohull, shaped by params: principal dimensions, bow and stern forms, sheer, deadrise and bilge, paint, bulwark / rail / fender, hull windows, superstructure tiers stacked from the deck, and an optional mast, radar arch and funnel. The default is a plain 20 m workboat with a small wheelhouse. Everything no param covers (fly-bridge furniture, cranes, guns, davits, towing gear) is added with custom ops.

loa_m.doc: Length overall, metres, including every overhang (swim platform, fenders, outboards, a RHIB tube's tails); the hull is shortened to make room. The origin is the waterline at the middle of this length.

beam_m.doc: Breadth overall, metres, fenders/tubes included. Must stay under loa_m / 1.5.

depth_m.doc: Keel to main deck edge amidships, metres. Freeboard amidships = depth_m - draught_m.

draught_m.doc: Draught, metres: the keel sits at minus this and nothing (props, rudders, outboard skegs) goes below it. Include the propellers in it, as a real vessel's quoted draught does.

bow_form.doc: plumb = near-vertical stem (workboats, older yachts); raked = stem swept forward at stem_rake_deg with a rising forefoot (modern motor yachts, fast craft, RHIBs); flared = raked plus a deck that stays wide forward (tugs, trawlers, OSVs); bulbous = bulb at the forefoot (merchant ships, large ferries); axe = vertical stem with a deep forefoot and fine entry (crew boats, Ulstein-X-bow style OSVs).

stem_rake_deg.doc: Stem rake from vertical, degrees, for raked / flared / bulbous bows (plumb and axe ignore it). Yachts 30-45, workboats 15-25.

stern_form.doc: transom = flat square stern; cruiser = rounded canoe stern with the keel rising (tugs, older ships); swim_platform = transom with a low platform aft (yachts); open = transom with nothing across it - bulwark, rail and fender/tube stop at the corners and a tube runs past the transom (RHIBs, open launches).

transom_rake_deg.doc: Transom slope, degrees: the top sits forward of the bottom. Not used by cruiser.

swim_platform_m.doc: Swim platform length aft of the transom, metres (stern_form swim_platform only); taken out of loa_m.

swim_platform_height_m.doc: Swim platform top above the waterline, metres.

sheer_fwd_m.doc: How much the deck edge rises at the bow above midships, metres (a tug's high bow 1.5-2.5, a yacht 0.5-1).

sheer_aft_m.doc: How much the deck edge rises at the stern above midships, metres (usually 0-0.3).

deadrise_deg.doc: Bottom V angle amidships, degrees (0 flat barge, 5-10 displacement, 12-18 semi-planing yacht, 20-26 deep-V RHIB/patrol). It sharpens automatically towards the bow.

bilge.doc: 0 = hard chine (planing yachts, RHIBs, patrol boats), 1 = fully round bilge (tugs, trawlers, ships).

fullness.doc: 0 = fine ends (fast yachts, patrol boats), 1 = long parallel midbody and full ends (barges, tugs, cargo ships).

hull_color.doc: Topsides paint above the boot top, RGB 0-1.

boot_top_color.doc: Boot-top band from the waterline to boot_top_m, RGB 0-1.

boot_top_m.doc: Height of the boot-top band above the waterline, metres (under 70% of the freeboard).

bulwark_m.doc: Solid bulwark height on the deck edge, metres; 0 = none. Closed across the transom unless stern_form is open.

bulwark_color.doc: Bulwark paint, RGB 0-1; null = same as hull_color.

rail_m.doc: Guard rail (stanchions and a top rail) height above the bulwark or deck edge, metres; 0 = none.

fender_m.doc: Diameter of a fender band / inflatable tube along the deck edge, metres; 0 = none. Tugs 0.4-0.8 (black rubber), RHIBs 0.45-0.65 (the collar). Taken out of beam_m and loa_m. Wraps the stern unless stern_form is open, where it runs past the transom and ends in cones.

hull_windows.doc: Windows in the hull sides (yachts): null, one object or a list of {x_aft_m, x_fwd_m, z_m (centre height above the waterline), height_m, color}. Each is a lens-shaped tinted strip on both sides following the hull.

tiers.doc: Superstructure tiers stacked from the deck up: tier 1 stands on the main deck, each next tier on the roof of the one before (Superstructure__Tier_1, _2, ...). Each is {x_aft_m, x_fwd_m (metres from amidships, + forward), width_m (at the base; clipped to the deck edge, error if wider than beam_m), height_m, setback_m? (each side's top is this much narrower than its base; negative flares out like a tug wheelhouse), rake_deg? (front leans aft by this much; negative leans forward), round? (0 square front .. 1 elliptical front in plan), overhang_m? (roof visor past the sides and front), overhang_aft_m? (roof extended aft, shading the deck behind), open? (true = coaming walls only, e.g. a fly-bridge; height_m is the coaming height), color, windows? (null, one object or a list of {color, bottom_m, height_m (both above the tier's base), aft? (wrap round the aft end too), aft_inset_m? (side band starts this far from the aft end)})}.

helm_tier.doc: Which tier the helm stands in: 1..n, 0 = on the main deck just aft of tier 1 (console boats), -1 = the highest closed tier at least 1 m high. The helm station, bridge eye and side lights follow it.

helm_x_m.doc: Helm position fore-and-aft, metres from amidships; null = near the front of the helm tier.

mast.doc: true = a tapered mast with a yardarm and a radar platform (Mast__Main), standing on the highest closed tier at mast_x_m, carrying the masthead light.

mast_x_m.doc: Mast position, metres from amidships; null = 40% along the top closed tier.

mast_height_m.doc: Mast height above what it stands on, metres.

radar.doc: true = a rotating radar scanner (Radar__Scanner) on the radar arch if there is one, else on the mast, else on the top tier.

radar_arch.doc: true = a radar arch (two raked legs and a cross-bar, Arch__Radar) on the highest tier (a fly-bridge's floor if the top tier is open) - motor yachts, patrol boats, RHIBs.

arch_x_m.doc: Arch position (its legs' feet), metres from amidships; null = middle of the top tier.

arch_width_m.doc: Arch span, metres (clipped to the tier it stands on).

arch_rake_deg.doc: Arch legs lean aft by this, degrees.

funnel.doc: true = funnel(s) on the highest closed tier at funnel_x_m (tugs, ships, older yachts).

funnel_count.doc: 1 = one centreline funnel (Funnel__Main), 2 = a side-by-side pair (Funnel__Port, Funnel__Stbd).

funnel_x_m.doc: Funnel position, metres from amidships; null = a quarter along tier 1.

funnel_height_m.doc: Funnel height above what it stands on, metres.

propulsion.doc: shaft = propellers with a rudder behind each (Hull__Propeller, Hull__Rudder - the rudders turn); azimuth = steerable Z-drive pods with nozzles under the stern (Hull__Azimuth, turn 360 - ASD tugs); outboard = outboard motors on the transom (Transom__Outboard, steer); waterjet = jet nozzles at the transom (Transom__Waterjet, steer); none.

engines.doc: Number of propellers / pods / outboards / jets.

strait_type.doc: StraitsSim vessel type written into the export package (not used for the geometry).

meta.name: Custom vessel (20 m workboat placeholder)
meta.notes: Placeholder from the general custom builder; the AI replaces these with researched figures for the vessel being made.
